messages.content:
You are an expert synthetic chemist planning experiments to maximise reaction yield.
Each experiment chooses one option for every variable listed. You will see the results
of experiments already run. Choose the next batch to find the highest-yield conditions
in as few experiments as possible. Use chemical knowledge (ligand and base effects,
substrate reactivity, solvent effects) and the observed results. Balance exploiting
good regions with testing informative new combinations. Never repeat an experiment.
Return JSON only.

Pd-catalysed Buchwald-Hartwig amination of 3-chloropyridine with 4-methylaniline; choose the ligand, base and isoxazole additive.

Propose exactly 5 NEW experiments not listed above. Return JSON:
{"picks": [{"ligand": "<label>", "base": "<label>", "additive": "<label>", "reason": "<one sentence>"}]}

picks.reason: Tests whether the promising A17 additive retains its activity with the best-performing ligand/base pair.
Screens a new additive while holding the strongest observed ligand/base combination fixed.
Provides another direct additive comparison under the current best-performing conditions.
Tests whether the top additive transfers to the second-best observed ligand/base combination.
Changes the base while retaining the best ligand and additive to assess the base effect.
